tagline: Bin diddigin tunani, ta hanyar kamararka
dropSub: Danna don bincika, ja fayil anan, ko liƙa hoto
dropHint: PNG · JPG · WEBP · HEIC, har zuwa 40MB
guideTitle: Yadda Giotto Sketch Studio Ke Aiki
guideSteps: Loda hoto da kake son amfani da shi azaman tunanin zane.
Daidaita shi da tacewa da sila: bayyana, kaifi, karfin gefe da sauransu.
Danna “Buɗe Kamara” don canzawa zuwa rayayyen bidiyon kamararka.
Hoton da aka gyara zai bayyana a saman kamara.
Sanya takardarka a ƙasa, cikin kallon kamara.
Ja, matse, ko juya rufin har sai ya daidaita da takardarka.
Daidaita bayyana, sannan danna “Fara Yanayin Zane” ka zana da hannu.
errUnsupported: Nau'in fayil da ba a tallafawa. Da fatan za a yi amfani da PNG, JPG, WEBP, ko HEIC.
errTooLarge: Fayil ɗin ya yi girma sosai. Iyakar girma shine 40MB.
errCantRead: An kasa karanta wannan hoto. Idan HEIC ne, gwada mayar da shi zuwa JPG tukuna.
errCamera: An hana samun kamara ko ba ta samuwa. Duba izinin burauza/shafi.
guidePrivacy: Sirri: komai yana faruwa a na'urarka. Hoton ka da bidiyon kamararka ba a taɓa loda su zuwa kowane sabar ba.
